children: NG Energy International shares rose after the company said it is ramping up natural-gas production in Colombia, allowing the company to sell uncontracted volumes into a tight Colombian energy market.
The Toronto-listed energy company on Friday reported that its Aruchara-6 well at the Maria Conchita block in Colombia achieved gross initial flow test rates of up to 8.7 million cubic feet a day.

The excess boosts total output to a gross figure of 23 million cubic feet a day, and brings NG Energy's production across its Maria Conchita and Sinu-9 assets to about 29.1 million cubic feet a day, the company said.

NG Energy said gas volumes over those covered under its existing contracted offtake agreements, for up to 15 million cubic feet a day gross at Maria Conchita, are being sold into the Colombian marketplace at average prices of approximately $14 to 16 per thousand cubic feet, with some volumes exceeding $20 per thousand cubic feet.
The company said the rates reflect the premium Colombian natural-gas pricing environment.
